message.content:
This vertical magazine cover illustration features a dark, minimalist composition with central figures and text. At the top, blue ribbon banners contain white text: "PEMIMPIN," "BUMN," and "PILIHAN." Below this, the large red word "TEMPO" is printed, with "EDISI 24-30 DESEMBER 2012" in small white letters underneath. To the left, white text reads "TABIR GELAP TRAGEDI SUKHOI."

A man in a pilot uniform is positioned in the center, seated and gripping a control yoke with both hands. He has grey hair, wears a white short-sleeved dress shirt with shoulder epaulets, and a black necktie. A black band or blindfold tightly covers his eyes. His skin is pale, and his expression is neutral. A dark, soft light illuminates him from the front against a black background.

In the bottom-left corner, a white rectangle contains a barcode, the number "00043," "RP 29.700," and several lines of small text, including "WWW.TEMPO.CO," "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN," and "ISSN: 0126-4273." A thin red vertical stripe borders the left edge of the entire image.
